identity: A mono-green ramp-combo whose only win condition is Dark Depths, and the only one of the three builds that both finds it and cannot protect it. Crop Rotation x2 puts the single mythic land onto the battlefield at instant speed for one green mana, and Fa'adiyah Seer x2 plus Sylvan Library dig for it every turn — green is the only colour in this cube that can search for a land at all. The thirty mana comes from breadth rather than burst: Gauntlet of Power doubles every basic Forest permanently, Elvish Aberration taps for three, Wild Growth and Werebear and Birds of Paradise each add one, and Krosan Restorer untaps up to three lands a turn once Threshold is on. There is no counterspell in green in this pool, which matters less than it looks: the {3} activation is an ability, not a spell, so there is no stack window to defend — the deck defends its life total with Werebear, Call of the Herd and Lull instead.

restrictions.extra_user_rule: At most 5 rare/mythic cards total across mainboard + sideboard; basic lands unlimited

mainboard.name: Dark Depths
mainboard.oracle_text:
Dark Depths enters with ten ice counters on it.
{3}: Remove an ice counter from Dark Depths.
When Dark Depths has no ice counters on it, sacrifice it. If you do, create Marit Lage, a legendary 20/20 black Avatar creature token with flying and indestructible.

mainboard.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {G}{G}{G}.

identity_es: Un combo-aceleración mono verde cuya única condición de victoria es Dark Depths, y la única de las tres construcciones que a la vez la encuentra y no puede protegerla. Crop Rotation x2 pone la única tierra mítica en el campo de batalla a velocidad de instantáneo por un maná verde, y Fa'adiyah Seer x2 más Sylvan Library cavan a por ella cada turno: el verde es el único color de este cubo que puede buscar una tierra siquiera. Los treinta manás vienen de la amplitud, no de la ráfaga: Gauntlet of Power duplica cada Forest básico de forma permanente, Elvish Aberration gira por tres, Wild Growth y Werebear y Birds of Paradise añaden uno cada uno, y Krosan Restorer desgira hasta tres tierras por turno una vez activo el Threshold. En verde no hay contrahechizos en este pool, lo que importa menos de lo que parece: la activación de {3} es una habilidad, no un hechizo, así que no hay ventana en la pila que defender; el mazo defiende su total de vidas con Werebear, Call of the Herd y Lull.
